subject: Demo request — Sakura Butsuryu (Osaka)
body:
お世話になっております。

We plan roughly 900 loads a month out of Osaka and Kobe and we are comparing three planning APIs. Could we book a thirty minute demo next week, ideally Tuesday or Wednesday morning JST? Three dispatchers would join.

We would want to see the carrier ranking explanation and how a dispatcher override works.

渡辺 健二 / Kenji Watanabe
Sakura Butsuryu

subject: Carrier ranking API for a 40-truck brokerage
body:
Hello,

We are a 40-truck brokerage in Columbus and we plan about 400 loads a week by hand. I want to understand what the ranking API returns and what Growth costs at our volume. We move mostly dry van, Midwest to Southeast.

Can you send pricing and a sense of what an integration looks like?

Dana Okafor
Umbrella Logistics

subject: Do you do last-mile grocery delivery routing?
body:
Hi there,

We run twelve vans doing same-day drops to grocery stores inside one city. No freight brokerage, no long haul, no carriers of our own. Someone told me Northwind does routing, so: does any of this apply to us, and what would it cost?

Marcus Reed
Breadbasket Bakeries

subject: Comment for a piece on carrier capacity data
body:
Hello,

I am writing a piece for Freightwire on how planning tools source carrier capacity, and whether the refresh intervals vendors advertise hold up in practice. Would someone at Northwind be willing to go on the record?

My deadline is 12 September.

Ivo Petrov
Freightwire

subject: Automatic reply: Out of office until 15 September
body:
I am out of the office until 15 September with limited access to email.

For anything about the Globex integration please contact the platform team.

Maya Idris

subject: Webhook retries not firing
body:
Hi,

Since the 0.3.1 upgrade our webhook retries are not firing. A delivery fails with a 500 from our endpoint, the dashboard shows the failure, and then nothing. No second attempt and no dead letter. We are on the Growth plan.

Is retry configurable per endpoint, or is something wrong on our side?

Nadia Farr
Cascade Carriers

Sam Ortega
Globex Freight, platform team
